title: Southeast Asian live streamers hustle to fuel booming e-commerce sales - South China Morning Post
text:
Southeast Asian live streamers hustle to fuel booming e-commerce sales | South China Morning Post Lifestyle & Culture - Lifestyle & Culture Southeast Asian live streamers hustle to fuel booming e-commerce sales Advertisement E-commerce This Week in Asia Lifestyle & Culture Southeast Asian live streamers hustle to fuel booming e-commerce sales 
 More live streamers are carving out an unconventional career path to tap into the multibillion-dollar market even as competition heats up
 4 -MIN READ 4 -MIN Listen Kolette Lim in Singapore Published: 6:00pm, 11 Nov 2026 Updated: 6:47pm, 11 Nov 2026 In a makeshift studio inside his public housing flat in Singapore , Shane Soh stands before his smartphone, running his fingers through a towel as he extols its softness to viewers watching his live stream. A ring light illuminates his face while more than a dozen other products sit on a shelf behind him, waiting for their moment on camera.
 “Don’t just buy one towel today, but get bedsheets as well. It’s perfect for Hari Raya or Christmas, and the thread count is 1,800 … It’s the best kind of quality you can get,” he tells hundreds of viewers on the other side of the screen.
